Our Story

From a kitchen table
to a growing movement.

📖 Our History

EcoGlow was founded in January 2026 by Bavly Awad, a 17-year-old from Toronto who grew tired of skincare brands making hollow "natural" claims while hiding synthetic fillers and microplastics in their formulas. Starting with five hand-researched products and a website he built himself, Bavly launched EcoGlow with zero outside investment and a very clear mission: make genuinely clean skincare that actually works. Within months, early customers found EcoGlow through TikTok and Instagram, and the response was immediate. Today, EcoGlow ships across Canada and donates a portion of every sale to reforestation charities — all run by one person who believes you don't need a team of fifty to do things right.

🌱 Our Purpose

EcoGlow exists to prove that skincare can be both effective and ethical. We believe every person deserves products that are safe for their skin and respectful of the planet. Our mission: eliminate toxic chemicals from daily routines, reduce plastic waste in the beauty industry, and inspire a generation of conscious consumers. We operate on three principles: transparency in our ingredients, sustainability in our packaging, and kindness in our community impact. As a Catholic-values aligned business, we embrace our duty as stewards of creation.

Our Commitment

Giving back to
the Earth we love.

At EcoGlow, profit is never more important than purpose. We are committed to environmental stewardship — because as people of faith and conscience, we are called to care for our common home.

🌳

Reforestation Canada — Trees Canada

EcoGlow donates 5% of every purchase to Trees Canada, a national reforestation charity that plants native trees in communities across the country. For every 50 products sold, we fund the planting of one new tree. To date, we have contributed to the planting of over 1,240 trees nationwide.

🐝

Pollinator Protection — Bee City Canada

We partner with the David Suzuki Foundation's Bee City Canada program to support pollinator-friendly gardening and habitat restoration. Healthy bees mean healthy ecosystems — and healthy natural ingredients for the products you love. Our Toronto HQ garden is a certified pollinator sanctuary.

♻️

Zero-Waste Take-Back Program

Return any empty EcoGlow container to receive a 10% discount on your next order. All returned containers are sanitized and recycled through our certified partner. Since launching this program in 2026, we have diverted over 600 containers from landfill.

How We Do It

How EcoGlow
is involved.

1

Ethical Sourcing

All ingredients are sourced from certified fair-trade suppliers. We audit our supply chain annually to ensure no exploitation of workers or natural environments at any stage.

2

Recyclable Packaging

Every EcoGlow product uses glass, aluminium, or compostable packaging. We have eliminated single-use plastic from our entire product line since 2026.

3

Carbon-Neutral Shipping

We offset 100% of shipping emissions through verified carbon programs. Our minimalist packaging also reduces material waste and shipping weight.

4

Community Education

EcoGlow hosts free monthly webinars on sustainable beauty, ingredient literacy, and eco-conscious living — open to anyone who signs up on our website.

"The earth is the Lord's and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it." — Psalm 24:1
EcoGlow draws inspiration from the Catholic principle of Stewardship — our duty to care for creation with humility, gratitude, and responsibility. Every product we make is a small act of love for the world we share.

The People Behind EcoGlow

Meet our team.

Founder & CEO

Bavly Awad

Bavly founded EcoGlow in early 2026 at 17 years old, after spending months frustrated that every "natural" skincare brand he looked into still used synthetic fillers, microplastics, or tested on animals. Armed with a self-taught background in coding and digital marketing — and a genuine obsession with ingredient labels — he launched EcoGlow from his bedroom in Toronto with a hand-blended batch of five products and a vision to do things differently.

What started as a weekend project grew into a real business within months. Bavly handles everything — product formulation research, the website, social media strategy, supplier relationships, and charity partnerships. He believes that being young is an advantage: "We don't have decades of bad habits to unlearn. We can just build it right from the start."

🧪 Product Formulation 📱 Digital Marketing 🌍 Sustainability
Questions & Answers

Frequently Asked
Questions

Are all EcoGlow products cruelty-free?
Yes — 100%. EcoGlow never tests on animals at any stage of production, and we only partner with ingredient suppliers who share this commitment. We are certified by the Leaping Bunny program.
Are your products suitable for sensitive skin?
Most of our products are formulated for all skin types including sensitive. Each product page includes a full ingredient list and skin-type guide. When in doubt, patch-test first and email us for personalized advice.
How does the container take-back program work?
Mail your empty EcoGlow containers back using our prepaid return label, available on the website. Once received, you get a 10% discount code for your next order. All containers are cleaned and sent to our certified recycling partner.
What is your return policy?
We accept returns on unopened, unused products within 30 days of delivery. If you received a damaged item, contact support@ecoglowskin.ca with a photo and we will send a replacement at no cost.
Do you ship outside of Canada?
Currently we ship across Canada and the continental United States. International shipping to the UK and EU is planned for 2027. Sign up for our email list to be notified when your region becomes available.
